entries.logic: Decouples the logic of switching views from the UI components. A NavigationService tracks the active Workspace and replaces its center node.
entries.rationale: Prevents circular dependencies between views and simplifies complex navigation flows (e.g., Back buttons, Deep-linking).

entries.logic: The primary UI container (WorkspacePane) registers itself with the NavigationService upon instantiation.
entries.rationale: Ensures that navigation commands always target the correct area of the screen, regardless of where they are triggered.
